## Goal

Summarize E207 contract vehicle analysis results and plan E208 field test

## Summary

Updated STATE.md and STATE-next-actions.md with E207 contract vehicle analysis completion. E207 analyzed 25,000 awards across 5 IT/software PSC codes, classifying contract vehicles via IDV PIID patterns. Key finding: DA10 is the only code where small vendors meaningfully use GWACs (28.2% via GSA MAS + SEWP); 7030 small vendors sell direct (88.7%); 7A21 is Army/Navy dominated with Carahsoft concentration; DA01/D304 are services/telecom markets. Next action: E208 field test with 3-5 small software companies.

## Next

E208: Field test - recruit 3-5 small software companies to validate assessment framework against real pipeline opportunities
